items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: It's one of those Barbarans, he was teaching over there, he was teaching how to play drums over there too. And they had a big band...

ctx.x: Isidore. Isidore? I think it's Isidore.

It's one of those Barbarans, he was teaching over there, he was teaching how to play drums over there too. And they had a big band, they played Lemon Drop, you know, it was very popular at the time. They'd bring stock arrangements in and the band would play. Yeah.
